title: Carbon in farmland
description: Store CO₂ in farm soils and trees, on part of the cropland or pasture, for some decades.

coverCrops.title: Cover crops
coverCrops.description: Crops grown between harvests store carbon in cropland soils.

agroforestry.title: Trees on farms
agroforestry.description: Trees planted in fields and pastures store carbon as they grow.

biochar.title: Biochar
biochar.description: Charred crop residues added to soil keep their carbon for centuries.

enhancedWeathering.title: Rock dust (experimental)
enhancedWeathering.description: Crushed basalt spread on fields takes up CO₂ as it weathers. Shown so far only in small field trials, which measure far less than models predict.
